nom: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Smooth-Glow Multi-Tasking Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally find the cream too heavy or dewy, especially in hot weather, with one noting a few pimples despite careful cleansing; other oily-leaning combination-skin reviewers say it balances their T-zone well.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin describe it as transformative, delivering deep, lasting hydration and softer skin, including one who calls it her new go-to after years of failed products.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin have mixed reactions: some say it successfully balances an oily T-zone with drier cheeks, while others find it feels heavy and greasy specifically in their oil-prone areas, especially in hot weather.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin say it doesn't irritate or cause breakouts, though a couple report their skin reacting poorly to daily use or being wary of its fragrance.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the moisturizer as deeply hydrating, especially those with dry skin who call it transformative; one longtime user says the reformulated version with SPF now feels heavy and greasy rather than simply hydrating like the original.
concerns.oiliness: Reports split by skin type: reviewers with oily or oil-prone T-zones often find the formula too heavy, dewy or greasy, especially in hot weather, while those with dry skin say the same richness works in their favor.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including some with adult acne, though one reviewer with oily skin says she got a few pimples from it despite careful cleansing.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports breaking out in a rash with hives after use, and a couple mention mild stinging if the product gets into the eyes; most other reviewers report no irritation.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers using it against fine lines and creases report their skin looking tighter and smoother with continued use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer who is prone to sun-triggered discoloration says regular use has helped prevent it from developing.

aspects.libelle: Reformulation with SPF feels heavier to some
Fragrance is strong for some, especially sensitive users
Reliable SPF 30 sun protection built in
Can pill when layered with other products
Small amount needed, good value for the jar

extraits.texte: I was a loyal customer because the original Hope in a Jar was truly one of a kind. It was lightweight, absorbed beautifully, and left my skin feeling hydrated without any greasy residue. My skin loved it, and it became my favorite moisturizer. Unfortunately, after the formula change, the experience is completely different. The added sunscreen makes the cream feel heavy, greasy, and uncomfortable on my skin. It leaves a shiny finish that looks and feels oily throughout the day. Instead of making my skin look healthy, it now makes it look worse. I was so disappointed that I ended up throwing both jars away. I really wish Philosophy would bring back the original formula or at least offer a version without sunscreen. It was a perfect moisturizer before, and it's heartbreaking to see such an amazing product changed so drastically.
Since I've tried this product including "When hope is not enough " I have broke out in a rash with hives. Please share what I should do for repair, I've never had this experience before.

extraits.titre: Effective but not for all skin types
extraits.texte: I was excited to try this since I will be outside a lot this summer and wanted a face moisturizer with SPF. This definitely provides the protection that you need. I am very fair and wore this on very sunny and hot days and I had no sunburn whatsoever. My biggest issue with this product is how heavy it is on the skin. I have oily skin which only gets worse when it's hot. When first putting this on it is VERY dewy and that lasts a long time. I could feel this laying on my skin even hours later. It has the consistency of not only sunscreen but a full coverage foundation but without the actual coverage. I'm very militant about washing my face and I still had a few pimples from this. Obviously your mileage may vary depending on your skin type. I will definitely still use this up but will be sure I'm not having my picture taken and will be a short outing so I can wash it off.

extraits.titre: Very creamy and pleasant smelling Moisturizer
extraits.texte: This moisturizer delivers exceptional dehydration and visibly smooths out uneven texture. I absolutely love the soft creamy texture and fresh pleasant scents. It feels incredibly luxurious upon application, however, as someone with combination skin and an already T-Zone the formula feels a bit too thick to my liking using it during a hot summer. They leave my skin feeling slightly weighed down and greasy in oil-prone areas. It is a fantastic resurfacing product, but it works much better as a rich nighttime treatment when the weather heats up.

extraits.titre: Absorbs quickly and leaves my skin soft and moisturized .
extraits.texte: I wish I would have tried this sooner! I have been looking for a great moisturizer that makes my skin glow without looking or feeling greasy, and this is it! Upon application, it feels lightweight, smooth, and soft. It absorbs within minutes and leaves my skin with a beautiful glow. I have combination skin (oily t zone and texture on my cheeks) and this helped balance both issues. I applied it yesterday at noon and it's now the next day at 9:45 am and my skin still feels incredibly soft without texture on my cheeks. I love that it's formulated with grafted hyaluronic acid and combined with microdoses of glycolic acid. It helps support skin natural hyaluronic acid production and it says this provides hydration that lasts and builds over time. I have tried a lot of moisturizers but none that have the ability to help your skin over time. My skin looks luminous thanks to the cryo tangerine complex from sub-zero cryoextraction .

⚠️ This product was provided to me by Influenster and Philosophy honest evaluation purposes. 🫧 The Philosophy Hope in a Jar Smooth-Glow Multi-Tasking Facial Moisturizer is an absolute game-changer for dry skin. It has a wonderful, luxurious texture that feels incredibly soft and smoothing upon application, and a little bit goes a long way. ​☀️ As a daily day cream, it delivers deep moisturization while offering the added benefit of SPF 30 protection against harmful UVA/UVB rays. Over time, it has noticeably transformed my skin, leaving it feeling significantly more supple, radiant, and hydrated. Definitely one to put on the repurchase list.
